acceptance_criteria.text: The Base branch and lands in inputs support searching for existing branches and creating new ones

facts:
This base branch input and the lands in input next to it are supposed to be combobox that I can search for an existing branch or create a new one.

This is feedback on Bridge's own UI, left with the annotation layer.
- Component: Input inside BranchPicker inside Where inside CardContent inside Card inside DispatchRequest
- Element: <div> reading "Base branch"
- Selector: #root > div.armada-shell div.armada-screen__pane > div.armada-card.armada-dispatch > div.armada-card-content > div.armada-dispatch__body > div.armada-dispatch__where > div.armada-input-field:nth-of-type(2)
- Screen: Overview
- Window: 1280×800
- Note file: .armada/annotations/20261003-002651-lequ.json

work_plan.approach: Both branch fields already render as searchable comboboxes (BranchPicker filters the repository's branches as you type). The gap is creation: only Lands in passes offerNew, so Base branch never offers "new branch <name>". The Judge refused the first plan for keeping Base existing-only; this plan reverses that, as the person asked. Pass offerNew to the Base branch picker in DispatchRequest's Where, so both fields offer a new-branch row when the typed name matches no branch. Then rewrite the prose that says only Lands in makes a branch (BranchPicker doc comment, Where doc comment, the dispatch-a-job journey), and update the tests that assert Base is existing-only (the StartingFromSomethingUnlisted story and the arc-dispatch mock test) to assert the new-branch row appears on Base and can be taken. Before editing, check consumers of refs.from in packages/screens/src/draft for any assumption that the base exists.
